#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
maildir=$base/Maildir
tmpdir=$maildir/tmp

mkdir -p "$tmpdir" "$maildir/accounts/new" "$maildir/support/new" "$maildir/general/new"
tmp=$(mktemp "$tmpdir/deliver.XXXXXXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' 0 HUP INT TERM
cat > "$tmp"

department=$(awk '
{
    line = $0
    sub(/\r$/, "", line)
    if (line == "")
        exit
    if (line ~ /^[ \t]/)
        next
    colon = index(line, ":")
    if (colon == 0)
        next
    name = tolower(substr(line, 1, colon - 1))
    if (name == "x-department") {
        value = substr(line, colon + 1)
        sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", value)
        sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", value)
        print tolower(value)
        exit
    }
}
' "$tmp")

case $department in
    accounts) destination=$maildir/accounts/new ;;
    support)  destination=$maildir/support/new ;;
    *)        destination=$maildir/general/new ;;
esac

name=$(basename -- "$tmp")
mv -- "$tmp" "$destination/$name"
trap - 0 HUP INT TERM
ANTRIEB_DELIVER_EOF
chmod 755 bin/deliver
printf '%s\n' 'INSTALLED'
stat -c '%U:%G %a %s %n' bin/deliver

printf '%s\n' 'SHELL_SYNTAX'
/bin/sh -n bin/deliver
